LightningComponentBundle.description: Horizontal multi-phase timeline. Auto-adapts default phases to the host object (Case=resolution, WorkOrder=intervention, Account/Opp=sales cycle, Home=fiscal). Custom JSON override. Today marker.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls card title and the default phases when Phases JSON is empty.

property.name: scope
property.label: Phases scope (default phases preset)
property.description: Picks which default phases preset is used when Phases JSON is empty. 'auto' (default) detects from the host object: Case → case resolution, WorkOrder/ServiceAppointment → field service, Account/Opportunity/Lead/Contact → sales cycle, Order/Contract → onboarding, Home/App → fiscal milestones. Override with a specific scope or paste your own JSON below.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the language default ('Parcours' / 'Journey').

property.name: phasesJson
property.label: Phases - JSON array (override)
property.description: JSON array — copy the placeholder shown in this field as a starting point. Each item needs: label (text), date (YYYY-MM-DD), done (true/false). Leave empty for the scope default.

property.name: hideTodayMarker
property.label: Hide 'Today' marker
property.description: Off by default - the vertical dotted line showing today's position is displayed.
